name: Goldream
source: 'Goldream' is an erotic visual novel that will pull you through a fun, sexy story with many twists and turns. You as the main character are brought to the city of Goldream, with a secret mission!
translation: 《金梦之城》是一部情色视觉小说，将带你踏上一段妙趣横生、性感火辣又峰回路转的故事旅程。身为男主角的你肩负着一项秘密使命，只身来到了繁华的“金梦城”！
